$comment: Golden set. Reference SQL runs as the same persona as the agent (same row-level security) with @Today = today's date in the persona's time zone. kind: answer | isolation | refusal. group: unseen (no worked example) | paraphrase (rewords an ai.Examples question). ordered: compare row order. prefix: the agent may return more rows; compare its first rows. forbidden: values that must never appear in any result (isolation).

cases.question: What was the average net revenue per order for each channel last month?
cases.sql: SELECT Channel, AVG(NetRevenue) AS AverageNetRevenue FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY Channel;

cases.question: Which location sold the most Timbits in September, and how many packs?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP (1) LocationName, SUM(Quantity) AS Packs FROM ai.OrderLines WHERE MenuItemName LIKE N'Timbits%' AND LocalDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today) - CASE WHEN MONTH(@Today) < 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 9, 1) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today) - CASE WHEN MONTH(@Today) < 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 10, 1) GROUP BY LocationName ORDER BY Packs DESC;

cases.question: How many orders did Union Station have yesterday?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocationName = N'Union Station' AND LocalDate = DATEADD(day, -1, @Today);

cases.question: Total tips by location last month
cases.sql: SELECT LocationName, SUM(Tip) AS Tips FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY LocationName;

cases.question: How many different loyalty members placed an order last month?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS Members FROM ai.Orders WHERE IsLoyaltyMember = 1 AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1);

cases.question: What were our net revenue and number of orders in the last 7 days, not counting today?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(day, -7, @Today) AND LocalDate < @Today;

cases.question: How many loyalty members do we have?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Members FROM ai.Customers;

cases.question: Which drink had the highest net revenue at Robson St last month?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP (1) MenuItemName, SUM(LineNetRevenue) AS NetRevenue FROM ai.OrderLines WHERE LocationName = N'Robson St' AND Category <> 'food' AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY MenuItemName ORDER BY NetRevenue DESC;

cases.question: What share of orders was placed on mobile at each location last month?
cases.sql: SELECT LocationName, AVG(CASE WHEN Channel = 'mobile' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS MobileShare FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY LocationName;

cases.question: How many refunds were issued for each reason in the last 90 days?
cases.sql: SELECT Reason, COUNT(*) AS Refunds FROM ai.Refunds WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, @Today) AND LocalDate < @Today GROUP BY Reason;

cases.question: What was the average tip percentage on delivery orders last month?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(Tip / NULLIF(Subtotal, 0)) AS AverageTipShare FROM ai.Orders WHERE Channel = 'delivery' AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1);

cases.question: How much did we refund on each channel last month?
cases.sql: SELECT Channel, SUM(Amount) AS Refunded FROM ai.Refunds WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY Channel;

cases.question: How many Glazed Donuts did each location sell last month?
cases.sql: SELECT LocationName, SUM(Quantity) AS GlazedDonuts FROM ai.OrderLines WHERE MenuItemName = N'Glazed Donut' AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY LocationName;

cases.question: Net revenue by day of the week over the last 4 weeks, not counting today
cases.sql: SELECT LocalDayOfWeek, SUM(NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(day, -28, @Today) AND LocalDate < @Today GROUP BY LocalDayOfWeek;

cases.question: What were the three busiest hours at Back Bay last month, by number of orders?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP (3) LocalHour, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocationName = N'Back Bay' AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY LocalHour ORDER BY Orders DESC;

cases.question: Monthly net revenue for Downtown Crossing over the last 3 complete months, oldest first
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocationName = N'Downtown Crossing' AND LocalDate >= DATEADD(month, -3, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)) AND LocalDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1) GROUP BY YEAR(LocalDate), MONTH(LocalDate) ORDER BY YEAR(LocalDate), MONTH(LocalDate);

cases.question: Over the past week, what was the busiest hour at each of our stores?
cases.sql: WITH hourly AS (SELECT LocationName, LocalHour, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM ai.Orders WHERE LocalDate >= DATEADD(day, -7, @Today) AND LocalDate < @Today GROUP BY LocationName, LocalHour) SELECT LocationName, LocalHour, Orders FROM (SELECT LocationName, LocalHour, Orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY LocationName ORDER BY Orders DESC) AS Ranking FROM hourly) AS ranked WHERE Ranking = 1;

cases.question: Month by month, what fraction of our lattes are made with oat milk?
cases.sql: SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(LocalDate), MONTH(LocalDate), 1) AS Month, AVG(CASE WHEN MilkType = 'oat' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS OatShare FROM ai.OrderLines WHERE IsLatte = 1 GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(LocalDate), MONTH(LocalDate), 1);

cases.question: What are our five best-selling drinks by net revenue so far this quarter?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP (5) MenuItemName, SUM(LineNetRevenue) AS NetRevenue FROM ai.OrderLines WHERE Category <> 'food' AND LocalDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), (DATEPART(quarter, @Today) - 1) * 3 + 1, 1) AND LocalDate <= @Today GROUP BY MenuItemName ORDER BY NetRevenue DESC;

cases.question: Compare the average tip percentage for mobile orders and in-store orders.
cases.sql: SELECT Channel, AVG(Tip / NULLIF(Subtotal, 0)) AS AverageTipShare FROM ai.Orders WHERE Channel IN ('mobile', 'in_store') GROUP BY Channel;
